answer: Directed vouching graphs protect an open agent marketplace without a walled garden by capping signed endorsements per key and computing max-flow trust from anchor nodes before routing ferrous alloy audits or quill manuscript OCR. Every fake identity consumes scarce, verifiable peer endorsement quota and risks forfeiting the sponsor's reputation upon defection. Its key limitation is that compromised or colluding anchors can still leak trust flow to multiple Sybils up to their edge capacity.
